description.value: Republica Coffee Roasters is a locally owned artisan coffee roasteria founded in 2007 and located in Fort Langley, BC's historic birthplace. The roastery specializes in single-estate fair trade organic coffees from around the world, roasted fresh to order and date-stamped for freshness. Cyclists can stop in at the Fort Langley storefront to pick up freshly roasted beans or browse their range of specialty blends and green beans.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 46m; stands (2 spaces) at 58m; stands (2 spaces) at 86m; stands (2 spaces) at 88m; stands (2 spaces) at 91m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active artisan coffee roastery with a retail storefront at 9203 Glover Rd, Fort Langley, matching the OSM address. The OSM phone number (604.628.0485) appears on the website's FAQ and wholesale contact sections, confirming it as a valid business number, though the Contact Us page lists a separate Fort Langley shop line (604.371.1083). No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities was found anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Website Contact Us page lists a separate Fort Langley shop phone (604.371.1083) distinct from the OSM number (604.628.0485), which the website associates with wholesale/general inquiries — cyclists calling the OSM number may reach a wholesale line rather than the shop directly.
Multiple locations referenced on website (Fort Langley, Cloverdale, and a North Vancouver map link) — this OSM record covers the Fort Langley location only.
Website does not clarify whether prepared drinks (espresso, drip coffee) are served on-site; the business appears primarily oriented to retail bean sales and online orders.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Fort Langley is a well-known cycling destination and this active artisan coffee roastery with a walk-in storefront is a worthwhile stop for touring cyclists seeking quality coffee and local character.

wow_evidence: locally owned artisan coffee roasteria founded in 2007
